title: Script Editor Opens Instead Of External Editor
body:
### Tested versions

Godot v4.8.beta1.mono

### System information

Godot v4.8.beta1.mono - Windows 11 (build 28000) - Multi-window, 3 monitors (1920x1080 @ 75.00 Hz, 1920x1080 @ 74.99 Hz, 2560x1440 @ 179.95 Hz) - Direct3D 12 (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1714) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-14700K (28 threads) - 31.69 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

In some circumstances , Script Editor opens while it should not. 

### Steps to reproduce

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/96a73aeb-17c8-46a4-8124-f61c1000104d

1- set VSCode as dotnet External Editor in preferences .
2- make a scene with 2 nodes.
3- attach both nodes C# code
4- click on first node (important) then click on script icon , it opens in vscode as usual.
5- now click on script icon second time , it switches tab to Script Editor. BUG
6- third , forth , ... click on script icon only opens in vscode as usual
7-now click on second node(important) , then click on it's script icon.  it opens in vscode as usual.
8- now click on script icon second time , it switches tab to Script Editor. BUG

it happens in 3D View and  also 2D View .


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[Bug2.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33604948/Bug2.zip)
